L01.text: Say you need a hotel. You just ask.

L02.text: It has its own private computer. It searches, compares, and finds the booking page.

L04.text: It remembers how you like things. So next time, just say: book the usual.

L05.text: Use it in the chat apps you already use, or on your laptop, browser and phone.

L06.text: Give it jobs before bed. It works through them overnight, and tells you in the morning.

L10.text: Headmaster. Your own agent, always on.

N1.text: Rather talk? Just call it, like you'd call a friend.

N2.text: Connect your email and calendar. It spots the confirmation and adds the trip for you.

N3.text: Snap a receipt. It files it and keeps the total.

N4.text: Big job? It splits the work between your profiles, then brings it all back together.

N5.text: Bring your team. Everyone gets their own agent, and you stay in charge.

N8.text: Need something every week? Say, every Monday at nine, send me my plan. It just happens.

N11.text: Most AI apps only talk. Yours actually does the job, from start to finish.

N12.text: No more ten different apps. One agent that knows you, and gets it all done.

V1.text: Before anything important, like booking, it checks with you. Approve once, always allow, or say no.

V2.text: Curious? Watch its computer at work, or take over any time.

V3.text: At work, hand it the busywork. Send it a spreadsheet, and it writes the one-page report.

V4.text: Running a business? Give each profile a job. Ada takes the orders, Milo watches the money, Juno writes the posts.

V5.text: Need something new? Add it from the Extensions store in one tap. It connects to the apps you already use.

V6.text: Already pay for ChatGPT or Claude? Bring that plan with you.
